title: Build the No-show Recovery Assistant Premium Blueprint (private preview)
objective:
Build the Premium Blueprint described in agent-specs/no-show-recovery-assistant.json. Read that spec, agents/standards.md, and AGENTS.md first.
Create the public guided demo at /blueprints/no-show-recovery-assistant and the signed-in Premium kit at /blueprints/no-show-recovery-assistant/kit.
Kit contents: No-show Recovery Setup Checklist; Confirm Attendance Prompt; Rebooking Draft Prompt; Consent and Repeat Policy Worksheet; Recovery Log Template; Send Review Checklist; Fictional Sample Booking Export; Data and Safety Guidance.
Follow every entry in the spec's constraints list.
Do not commit, push, merge, deploy, or publish.
acceptance_criteria: GET /blueprints/no-show-recovery-assistant without a session renders a page whose h1 is 'No-show Recovery Assistant', with a visible 'Private preview' label.
The guided demo page's HTML contains a robots meta tag whose content includes 'noindex' and 'nofollow'.
The guided demo page shows the fictional data notice text exactly as specified in guided_demo.fictional_data_notice, above the first demo step.

The guided demo is a six-step stepper. It shows the text 'Step N of 6', a 'Next step' button (absent or disabled on step 6), and a 'Previous step' button (absent or disabled on step 1). Each step has a visible heading.

Step 1 shows a booking table with exactly 5 data rows whose client names are J. Rivera, A. Chen, M. Okonkwo, S. Patel, and R. Kim, and an open-slot table containing 'Thu', '2:00' or '14:00', 'Fri', '9:30', 'Cut & color', 'Consult', and 'Color'. It also shows '2026-10-14' and '3'.

Step 2 shows the exact heading 'CONFIRM ATTENDANCE FIRST'. J. Rivera is listed as a confirmed no-show. A. Chen is SKIPPED with text containing 'attended' and the exact sentence 'Do not message someone who attended.'. S. Patel is SKIPPED with text containing 'cancelled'. M. Okonkwo is SKIPPED FOR SMS with text containing 'sms_consent' and 'no'. R. Kim is FLAG FOR POLICY with text containing 'prior_no_shows' and '2'.

Step 3 shows the draft text 'Hi J., we missed you today. Would Thu 2:00 or Fri 9:30 work instead?'. It shows the text labels 'CONFIRMED', 'AI INTERPRETATION', and 'RECOMMENDED ACTION' as visible words, not as color or icon alone. CONFIRMED text contains 'J. Rivera', '10:00', 'Cut & color', 'no_show', and 'yes'. AI INTERPRETATION contains 'no arrival time' and 'not a promise they remain open'. RECOMMENDED ACTION contains 'Do not send this draft.'. The page states that Thu 11:00 Consult is not offered because the service does not match.

Step 4 shows the J. Rivera CONFIRMED line. Activating 'Check facts against the booking row' reveals three rows (status, sms_consent, open slots), each containing the text 'Matches', and the values no_show, yes, and Thu 2:00.

Step 5 shows R. Kim with FLAG FOR POLICY and prior_no_shows 2, the exact sentences 'A third no-show is a policy decision, not an automatic text.' and 'Confirm consent before any message.', M. Okonkwo still skipped for missing consent, and 'No deposit is charged from this kit.'.

Step 6 contains the exact sentences 'You review and send. The kit changes nothing.' and 'Do not send this draft.' and a link to /blueprints/no-show-recovery-assistant/kit whose visible text says sign-in is required and the kit is a private preview.
Every client name, time, service, status, consent value, prior_no_shows count, and open slot in the demo matches the guided_demo.sample_input rows and sample_output exactly.
Neither page contains the text 'checkout', 'buy now', 'purchase', 'Buy Premium', '/month', 'per month', or a price. Neither page contains a dollar amount.
Neither page contains a percentage, a recovery-rate figure, an hours-saved figure, or an ROI or savings claim.
The homepage (/) and the site header contain zero links whose href includes '/blueprints/no-show-recovery-assistant', and /sitemap.xml does not contain '/blueprints/no-show-recovery-assistant'.
GET /blueprints/no-show-recovery-assistant/kit without a session redirects to /auth with the query parameter next=/blueprints/no-show-recovery-assistant/kit.

No-show Recovery Assistant is registered in src/lib/blueprints.ts with id and productSlug 'no-show-recovery-assistant', access 'premium', href '/blueprints/no-show-recovery-assistant/kit', purchaseHref '/blueprints/no-show-recovery-assistant', and badge PREMIUM. It is not added to PAID_PRODUCTS and has no Stripe price.

The kit page calls requireUser('/blueprints/no-show-recovery-assistant/kit') from src/lib/auth.ts and hasActiveEntitlement(user.id, 'no-show-recovery-assistant') from src/lib/payments/access.ts. It exports metadata with robots { index: false, follow: false }.

With an authenticated entitled session, the kit page renders h1 'No-show Recovery Assistant Premium Kit' and the exact label text 'Premium · Private preview'. Kit resource and interaction criteria below apply only to this entitled state.

With an authenticated session that has no No-show Recovery Assistant entitlement, the kit page renders h1 'Premium is locked', does not render kit content sections such as #setup-checklist, and does not show a Buy Premium button or a Stripe price.

The kit page shows 8 resource sections with headings matching the kit_contents titles, each with an element id equal to its kit_contents id. A table of contents at the top links to each section with an href of '#<id>'.

The Confirm Attendance Prompt is shown in a <pre> element and contains these strings: 'CONFIRM ATTENDANCE FIRST', 'CONFIRMED', 'AI INTERPRETATION', 'RECOMMENDED ACTION', 'attended', 'cancelled', 'Do not message someone who attended', 'Do not invent', 'Do not send', 'Confirm consent before any message'.

The Rebooking Draft Prompt is shown in a <pre> element and contains: 'only after', 'attendance', 'sms_consent', 'open slots', 'match the missed service', 'FLAG FOR POLICY', 'Do not send', 'Do not invent', 'You review and send'.

Each prompt has a 'Copy Prompt' button that writes the exact <pre> text to the clipboard and changes its label to 'Copied'. If the clipboard is unavailable, it shows a visible error telling the person to copy manually.

The Consent and Repeat Policy Worksheet has a visible label 'Repeat no-show threshold including today' whose default value is '3', a visible label 'Statuses that are never a no-show (one per line)' whose default value is 'cancelled', a visible label 'Clients to always skip (one per line)', plus a 'Generate My Recovery Rules' button.

With the defaults, the generated rules block contains 'Confirm status = no_show against the booking row before any draft.', 'Never draft for attended.', 'Never treat cancelled as a no-show.', 'SMS draft only when sms_consent = yes and contact_pref = sms.', 'Confirm consent before any message.', 'Flag when this miss reaches the repeat threshold of 3.', 'Offer only open slots that match the missed service.', and 'Do not send. You review and send. The kit changes nothing.' The block has a Copy button. The block contains no 'Always skip' line.
If the repeat-threshold field is empty, 0, or negative, the worksheet shows the error 'Enter a repeat no-show threshold of 1 or more.' and generates no rules block.
When 'Clients to always skip (one per line)' is empty, the generated rules block contains no 'Always skip' line. When it contains 'R. Kim', the block contains 'Always skip: R. Kim'.
When 'Statuses that are never a no-show (one per line)' contains 'cancelled' and 'rescheduled' on two lines, the generated rules block contains 'Never treat cancelled; rescheduled as a no-show.'.

The Recovery Log Template shows the columns as_of, time, client, service, status, channel, sms_consent, prior_no_shows, slots_offered, action, outcome. Its 'Copy CSV' button writes text whose first line is 'as_of,time,client,service,status,channel,sms_consent,prior_no_shows,slots_offered,action,outcome' and whose J. Rivera row contains '2026-10-14', '10:00', 'Cut & color', 'no_show', 'yes', and 'drafted_not_sent'.

The Send Review Checklist shows 9 checkbox items with visible labels, a progress line 'Checked N of 9', and a 'Reset checklist' button that sets the count back to 0. Progress is not saved beyond the browser session.

The Fictional Sample Booking Export section is labelled 'Fictional' and its Copy CSV text equals the time,client,service,status,contact_pref,sms_consent,prior_no_shows rows and header from guided_demo.sample_input.
The Setup Checklist and the Data and Safety Guidance sections each state that file upload support and data controls in ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini differ by plan, account, and admin settings.
The kit page says that worksheet entries and checklist progress stay in this browser session and are not saved to Atlas.
With an authenticated entitled session, /my-blueprints shows the No-show Recovery Assistant card as Unlocked with an Open Blueprint link to /blueprints/no-show-recovery-assistant/kit.

With an authenticated session that has no No-show Recovery Assistant entitlement, /my-blueprints shows the No-show Recovery Assistant card as Locked with an Available to purchase link to /blueprints/no-show-recovery-assistant and no link to the kit.

With an authenticated session, /my-blueprints still shows the free Daily Inbox Starter Kit with Open Starter Kit pointing at /blueprints/daily-inbox-briefing/starter-kit. AI Collections Assistant entitlement, Buy Premium, and checkout behavior are unchanged. Security Readiness Action Pack, Google Ads Performance Coach, Quote Request Assistant, and AI Expense Watchdog entitlement and locked or unlocked card behavior are unchanged.

At a 393px-wide viewport, neither page scrolls horizontally (document scrollWidth minus clientWidth is 1px or less) on any demo step or kit section. Tables either wrap or scroll inside their own container.

Every interactive control on both pages can be reached with Tab and activated with Enter or Space, and shows a visible focus ring. After 'Next step' or 'Previous step', focus moves to the new step's heading.
Loading both pages produces no unexpected browser console errors or page errors, as judged by the e2e/support/fixtures.ts console filter.

Product implementation files live under app/blueprints/no-show-recovery-assistant/, components/premium/no-show-recovery-assistant/, and src/lib/premium/no-show-recovery-assistant/. The Blueprint registry entry lives in src/lib/blueprints.ts. e2e/no-show-recovery-assistant/authenticated.spec.ts is the protected acceptance test and must not be weakened, skipped, rewritten, or have assertions removed.

Authenticated QA uses the repository's automatic Playwright session refresh. If the session cannot be refreshed, QA stops with AUTH_SESSION_REFRESH_REQUIRED and that failure is not treated as a product defect.
The guided demo at /blueprints/no-show-recovery-assistant renders without sign-in on desktop and a phone-sized viewport, uses only fictional data, and says so.
The kit at /blueprints/no-show-recovery-assistant/kit requires sign-in, is labelled Premium · Private preview, and shows no price, checkout, or purchase claim.
Both pages set robots noindex and are not linked from the homepage, header, or sitemap.
Confirmed facts, AI interpretation, and recommended actions are labelled separately, and every external action stays with the person.
The Daily Inbox Briefing, its Starter Kit, and its tests are unchanged.
